result.title: SIMBAD: Spatio-Temporal Traffic Forecasting Robust to Aperiodicity
result.comment: Total of 30 pages, 9 figures (4 in main, 5 in appendix), accepted to NeurIPS(Neural Information Processing Systems) 2026
result.summary: Accurate traffic prediction is essential for urban planning but remains challenging due to the irregular patterns caused by unexpected events. While Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks (STGNNs) effectively model periodic data, they often struggle with these aperiodic fluctuations. To address this, we propose SIMBAD, which improves generalization irregular patterns via two key mechanisms: 1) adaptive regulation of periodic signals to prioritize recent signals, and 2) dynamic spatial modeling that adjusts influence between connected nodes based on contextual relations. Built upon simple similarity metrics to adapt to aperiodic patterns, SIMBAD outperforms existing methods on real-world benchmark datasets, demonstrating superior performance in predicting unseen and irregular traffic events.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SIMBAD，通过自适应调节周期信号以偏重近期信号、并按上下文化关系动态调整节点间影响，缓解交通时空预测中的非周期波动。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于时空图网络交通预测的应用改进，其周期信号调节与相似度驱动的动态图权重均为通用时序建模手段，未涉及多模态推理中的状态表示、证据筛选或停止决策，缺乏可核查的具体借鉴线索。
